head: #[#set std.raw(lang: none, theme: none);#show std.raw: it => { set std.text(font: ("DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Serif CJK SC"), size: 11pt, weight: 400, style: "normal", tracking: 0pt, dir: ltr, lang: "en", hyphenate: false, fill: std.rgb("#273449")); let body = it.lines.map(line => line.body).join(std.linebreak()); if it.block { set std.par(justify: false, leading: 0.65em); std.block(width: 100%, breakable: true, fill: std.rgb("#f3f5f8"), stroke: 0.5pt + std.rgb("#cbd3df"), radius: 4pt, inset: (x: 9pt, y: 7pt), above: 0.5em, below: 0.5em, body) } else { std.highlight(fill: std.rgb("#eef1f5"), radius: 2pt, extent: 2pt, body) } };
formulaHead: #[#set std.raw(lang: none, theme: none);#show std.raw: it => { set std.text(font: ("DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Serif CJK SC"), size: 11pt, weight: 400, style: "normal", tracking: 0pt, dir: ltr, lang: "en", hyphenate: false, fill: std.rgb("#65458b")); let body = it.lines.map(line => line.body).join(std.linebreak()); if it.block { set std.par(justify: false, leading: 0.65em); std.block(width: 100%, breakable: true, fill: std.rgb("#f4f1f8"), stroke: 0.5pt + std.rgb("#d4c8e2"), radius: 4pt, inset: (x: 9pt, y: 7pt), above: 0.5em, below: 0.5em, body) } else { std.highlight(fill: std.rgb("#f4f1f8"), radius: 2pt, extent: 2pt, body) } };
